name: Hero Mode
how: Beat the game once. Available as a new save: hearts no longer drop from enemies and damage taken is doubled.

name: Swift Sail
how: Beat the game once. The King of Red Lions always sails at max speed without holding any button down.

name: Extra credits content
how: Finish the game to see additional artwork and scenes during the closing credits.

title: Clear the main dungeon before chasing hearts
body: Each dungeon usually unlocks a new tool (Grappling Hook, Hookshot, Mirror Shield) that opens up parts of the Great Sea you couldn't reach before — don't get stuck on a Piece of Heart that seems out of reach yet.

title: Get the Wallet+ as soon as you can
body: With a 200-rupee cap you can't even afford one Triforce Chart. Visit Tingle on Rock Spire Isle the moment you have rupees to spare.

title: Buy the Cannon early
body: Many Pieces of Heart and Charts depend on sinking warships or hitting distant switches — the Cannon pays for itself.

title: Save the Savage Labyrinth for last
body: With the Master Sword at full power and hearts maxed out, all 50 floors go a lot faster.

title: Save the Triforce Charts for the second stretch
body: You can't enter Ganon's Tower without all eight — but you don't have to decipher every one before the Earth and Wind Temples either; let the story and the charts progress together.

title: Chase 100% on a Hero Mode replay
body: The second playthrough is the best time to go for full completion: you already know every island and every chart, so you can focus on the challenge instead.
